title: Event envelope v2 fields (open base)
description: Shared v0.2 envelope fields. Not closed: validate against append.json or stored.json, never against this schema alone. type, actor and payload are checked per type by the v2 dispatch, which harness.core.contract_schemas assembles from payload files declaring 'x-envelope: 2'.

id.description: Client-generated; also the idempotency key (a resend with the same id is the same event).

type.description: '<resource>.<past tense>', with a '.v<n>' (n >= 2) suffix only after a breaking change. Payload schema: events/payloads/<type without suffix>/<n or 1>.json.
